design: Equivalent-evidence representation audit. All three views include identical normalized capabilities, identity annotations and source metadata. facts-json retains the original fact structures plus shared annotations; it is not the exact older raw-facts baseline.
actor_boundary: Each recommender is limited to its own provider. Buyer access, when integrated, requires explicit visible IDs. No hidden preference brief is loaded.
comparison_limit: This audit measures retrieval coverage, equality and serialized size, not model behavior, revenue, satisfaction or a graph treatment effect. Queries are fixed examples, not selected by an agent.
